description: This file defines the CustomerOption class, which models a customer attribute option with properties such as type, name, default value, and available values. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable, indicating it's a persistent entity used within the application's customer attribute management.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Represents a customer attribute option, including its type, name, default value, and list of available values. Extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the customer option.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the customer option.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer option.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for this customer option.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for this customer option.

methods.name: getAvailableValues
